_reference.english: Give all other allies Barrier and [Magic + 1] Life. Create 10 Gems of a chosen Color.

sourceEvidence.note: Entity troop:6365 SpellId/English text/ManaCost/ManaColors asserted verbatim in tests/unit/gowLaneL4bB01.test.ts.
SpellId 7517 Cost and every SpellSteps field (ordered, toEqual) asserted in tests/unit/gowLaneL4bB01.test.ts.
official-status-effects.html: Barrier protects from one instance of damage then is removed; Blessed troops are immune to status effects (Blessed-ally case: Barrier refused, Life still applied).

identity-cost-colors.note: troop 6365 -> spell 7517; raw ManaCost 24 = native Cost 24; colours Green+Yellow+Purple in raw _ManaColors_parsed and src troops manaColors; spell.id binding asserted.

target-count-range.note: AllAlliesButNotSelf -> allyOthers: both other living allies (ids 1,2) get Barrier+Life, caster excluded, defeated ally skipped, lone caster gets no status/buff; enemies untouched. Create count 10 fixed.

base-formula-rounding.note: IncreaseHealth Amount 1 SpellPowerMultiplier 1 = [Magic+1]: magic 0 -> +1, magic 10 -> +11 (maxHp and hp both 1000+magic+1). Create count base 10 mult 0 -> exactly 10 cells.

boost-source-ratio-cap.note: No Count*/UseCounterForAmount/StatusModifier step in native; prototype has no modifier; English has no boost clause.

conditions-probabilities-branches.note: Single unconditional main branch; no Randomize/Chance/condition in native steps or prototype.

status-duration-immunity.note: Barrier status-apply turns 3 on each other ally (project Barrier convention, same as accepted troop:6081); Blessed ally refuses Barrier but still gains Life; caster not shielded.

gems-types-selection-resolution.note: Color1 FromTarget with spell Target ManaGemsOnly -> CHOSEN colour via ColorChooser; chosen Red and Green each produce 10 gems of that specific colour from non-chosen distinct cells; 3 empty cells filled by gem-create first then 7 gem-transform; only 4 convertible cells -> only those 4 convert. Created-gem matches resolve through the normal board pipeline.

summon-transform-pools.note: No summon or troop transform step.

order-death-retargeting.note: Order Barrier -> Life -> create matches native order (status-apply events precede gem events); defeated ally skipped, no retargeting required.

mana-economy-extra-turn.note: Cast sets caster mana to 0; any later caster mana equals cascade match mana-gain events (board source); no extra-turn in skill phase; turn passes unless a cascade 4+ match awards one; one action log entry.

display-description.note: Chinese '赋予所有其他盟友屏障效果并给予 [魔法 + 1] 点生命值。创造 10 颗指定颜色宝石。' matches English clauses and scaling; English asserted verbatim.

battle-pipeline.note: Real TurnEngine.castSkill on Left and Right sides with Magic 0/10; low mana (23) and Silence refuse without spending mana or changing board, statuses or action log.

clauseReviews.text: Give all other allies Barrier and [Magic + 1] Life.
clauseReviews.note: Barrier (turns 3) and [Magic+1] maxHp/hp on each other living ally; caster excluded; Blessed ally immune to Barrier only; dead ally skipped.

clauseReviews.text: Create 10 Gems of a chosen Color.
clauseReviews.note: Exactly 10 gems of the chosen specific colour (Red/Green tested) created; empty-first then full-board conversion; insufficient-convertible board converts only the available 4 cells.

nativeStepReviews.note: CauseBarrier AllAlliesButNotSelf -> status barrier allyOthers turns 3; asserted via status-apply events and statuses.
IncreaseHealth Amount 1 x SpellPower -> buff hp base1 mult1 lifeMode gain; maxHp and hp both +magic+1.
CreateGems Color1 FromTarget Amount 10 -> create CHOSEN count 10; gem-create/gem-transform counted per colour.

branchReviews.note: Single main branch: all three steps executed in order on every successful cast; refusal paths (low mana / silence) execute none.
